nodes.description: Immutable public initial interest rate set at construction
Immutable lower bound clamped on the resulting interest rate
Immutable upper bound clamped on the resulting interest rate
Immutable aggressiveness factor between 0 and 1e18 used to scale rate movement
Constructor validating min<max and adjustRate<1e18 and assigning immutables
External view computing the next interest rate from utilization and elapsed time
block.timestamp, the time source behind the timePassed argument driving rate rebase
Arithmetic totalAvailable + totalLoan computing total liquidity
Arithmetic (totalLoan * 1e18) / totalLiquidity computing utilization rate
Arithmetic scaling of rate: adjustRate*scale*cappedtimePassed, prevRate*multRate, upMaxRate = 1e36/(1e18-adjustRate)-1e18
Parameter prevRate: current interest rate fed into target rate computation
Parameter totalAvailable: available liquidity used in liquidity and utilization math
Parameter totalLoan: outstanding loan used in liquidity and utilization math
Parameter timePassed: seconds since last rebase, derived from block.timestamp
Constructor parameter _initialRate assigned to immutable initialRate
Constructor parameter _minRate assigned to immutable minRate
Constructor parameter _maxRate assigned to immutable maxRate
Constructor parameter _adjustRate assigned to immutable adjustRate
Local totalLiquidity = totalAvailable + totalLoan
Local utilRate = (totalLoan * 1e18) / totalLiquidity
Local cappedtimePassed = min(timePassed, 1 days)
Local multRate multiplier chosen per utilization bracket
Local targetRate = (prevRate * multRate) / 1e18 before clamping

edges.reason: The elapsed time fed as timePassed originates from block.timestamp and controls the interest rate rebase in getNextInterestRate
timePassed parameter is consumed by getNextInterestRate to cap and scale the rate change
totalAvailable is summed into totalLiquidity by an arithmetic operation
totalLoan is summed into totalLiquidity by an arithmetic operation
totalLoan is multiplied by 1e18 and divided by totalLiquidity when computing utilRate
prevRate is multiplied by multRate inside the rate arithmetic path
prevRate parameter is read by getNextInterestRate as the base rate
adjustRate scales the rate movement and appears in the division 1e36/(1e18-adjustRate)
minRate is used as the lower clamp of the arithmetic result
maxRate is used as the upper clamp of the arithmetic result
totalLiquidity local feeds the utilization rate division
utilRate local selects and scales the multiplier arithmetic
cappedtimePassed local is multiplied into the rate adjustment arithmetic
multRate local is multiplied with prevRate in the final rate arithmetic
targetRate local is the clamped arithmetic result returned by the function
